$comment: Seed catalogue (PRODUCTION_PLAN task 2.13). Source: AstraPlugins/examples/json-tools/plugin.toml at version 0.1.1, transcribed by hand. A TypeScript plugin: one noarch artifact, and the user's own Node runtime.
name: JSON Tools
summary: Format, query and diff JSON, in conversation and in commands.
description: Three tools the assistant can call — pretty-print JSON at a chosen indent, extract a value by dot-path, and diff two documents path by path — plus a JSON Transform action for the command editor that formats, minifies, sorts keys or extracts a path and stores the result in a variable. Requires Node.js 18 or newer on the machine running Astra; the bundle declares node as a runtime so the daemon refuses to start it rather than failing halfway.
